blue-alternating-leaf-vine.description: One vertical repeat of a vine in flat mid blue on an opaque pale blue ground. A thin stem loops into two rounded coils, each enclosing a large five-lobed leaf, the leaves pointing alternately up to the right and down to the left, with small three-leaf clusters on short tendrils in the gaps. The top and bottom edges join seamlessly when stacked. Not transparent.
blue-alternating-leaf-vine.quality: The pale blue ground is opaque, so the piece cannot sit on another colour without recolouring.
blue-alternating-leaf-vine.title: Blue vine with alternating lobed leaves

corner.description: Mitred top-left corner in the same stencil blue on the same graph paper, a single curl turning the angle, its right and bottom edges matching the tile's ends.

blue-alternating-stencil-scroll.description: One horizontal repeat of a stencilled scroll in bright royal blue on the untouched white sheet, whose grey graph-paper grid shows through. Two S-curved stems with round bud-like ends carry curving acanthus leaf tips and small teardrop leaves, the second curl being the first turned over; the stencil bridges leave every shape as a separate cut piece. The left and right edges join seamlessly. The ground is opaque.
blue-alternating-stencil-scroll.quality: Opaque white ground with the source sheet's grey grid lines kept.
blue-alternating-stencil-scroll.title: Blue stencil scroll with alternating leaves
usage_notes: The graph-paper background is intentional; the paper grid and the ornament repeat have different periods, so the grid steps slightly at each join.

corner.description: Mitred top-left corner in the same flat blue, a single scroll loop with a bird turning the angle and a leaf sprig at the vertex, its right and bottom edges matching the tile's ends.

blue-bird-and-fan-scroll-border.description: One repeat of a border in flat mid blue on an opaque pale blue ground. Two heart-shaped scroll loops rise side by side, the left one enclosing a serrated fan on a curled stem and the right one a long-necked wading bird standing on a leaf and facing right; a fan-shaped palmette fills the gap between them below, with small leaf sprigs along the bottom edge. The left and right edges join when repeated, but the repeat is barely wider than it is tall. Not transparent.
blue-bird-and-fan-scroll-border.quality: The pale blue ground is opaque, so the piece cannot sit on another colour without recolouring.
blue-bird-and-fan-scroll-border.title: Blue border with wading bird, fan and palmette

blue-diamond-leaf-stencil-band.description: One horizontal repeat of a stencilled band in bright royal blue on the untouched white graph-paper sheet. A wavy stem throws off two curling S-scrolls, each carrying a sprig of three leaves with a pointed central one, the sprigs pointing alternately up and down; a straight stencil-cut rule with bridge gaps runs along the top and bottom edges. The left and right edges join seamlessly. The ground is opaque, with the sheet's grey grid visible.
blue-diamond-leaf-stencil-band.quality: Opaque white ground with the source sheet's grey grid lines kept.
blue-diamond-leaf-stencil-band.title: Blue stencil band with three-leaf sprigs

blue-looped-quatrefoils.description: A single quatrefoil in flat mid blue on an opaque pale blue ground. Four pointed oval loops meet at the centre, each holding a trefoil bud on a pointed leaf, with a small three-lobed sprig in each diagonal gap. The motif is symmetric about both axes and its edges join when the piece is repeated, but it is about as tall as it is wide. Not transparent.
blue-looped-quatrefoils.quality: The pale blue ground is opaque, so the piece cannot sit on another colour without recolouring.
blue-looped-quatrefoils.title: Blue looped quatrefoil

blue-oak-leaf-and-acorn-strip.description: A narrow vertical strip of four clusters of lobed oak-like leaves with cross-hatched acorns, in flat mid blue on an opaque pale blue ground. The two upper clusters sweep one way and the two lower ones are the same pair turned 180 degrees, so the strip reads the same from either end; leaf tips and acorns reach the strip's edges. The ends do not join as a repeat. Not transparent.
blue-oak-leaf-and-acorn-strip.quality: The pale blue ground is opaque, so the piece cannot sit on another colour without recolouring.
blue-oak-leaf-and-acorn-strip.title: Blue oak leaf and acorn strip

blue-staggered-leaf-scrolls.description: One repeat of a vertical border in flat mid blue on an opaque pale blue ground. C-scrolls with dotted terminals are stacked in two staggered columns along a central stem, and each throws off small pointed leaves and a fan of serrated leaves so that the leaves of one column point into the gaps of the other. The top and bottom edges join when stacked, but the repeat is about as tall as it is wide. Not transparent.
blue-staggered-leaf-scrolls.quality: The pale blue ground is opaque, so the piece cannot sit on another colour without recolouring.
blue-staggered-leaf-scrolls.title: Blue scroll border with small leaves

butterfly-panel-red.description: A tall narrow panel on a mottled gold ground inside a dark brown ruled border, holding a column of about twelve painted butterflies and moths in white, cream, brown, orange and speckled grey, with small blue flowers and sprigs of red berries between them. At each end a crimson acanthus finial with a small blue flower cap grows out of the border. The sheet outside the panel is transparent.
butterfly-panel-red.quality: The panel's interior sits at about 95 percent alpha rather than fully opaque, so a dark ground shows faintly through it.
butterfly-panel-red.title: Gold panel of butterflies with crimson finials

floral-bird-panel-blue.description: A tall narrow panel on a mottled gold ground inside a dark brown ruled border. From the top it holds a white rose with a small fly, an orange and black butterfly, a pink rose with a bud, a blue bird clinging head downward to a stem, a second pink rose, a purple butterfly, a yellow rose, a second blue bird head downward on a crimson rose, and a dark beetle, all on thin green stems. At each end a bright blue acanthus finial with a gold leaf cap grows from the border. The sheet outside the panel is transparent.

From the top it holds a snail on a leaf, a red rose, a blue star-shaped flower, a brown butterfly, a purple pansy, a fly, a goldfinch facing right, a pink flower, a speckled butterfly, a strawberry with white blossoms, a red-breasted finch facing right, violets, a round leaf, a brown butterfly and a blue iris. gold-scroll-with-blue-bellflowers.description: A horizontal flourish drawn in flat gold with black outlines on an opaque white ground. A long S-curved acanthus stem with curling leaf ends at both sides throws off five blue and white bellflowers on short stalks, two hanging below the stem and three standing above it. A thin black rule runs along the top edge. Not transparent.
gold-scroll-with-blue-bellflowers.quality: Opaque white ground, so the piece cannot sit on another colour without recolouring.
gold-scroll-with-blue-bellflowers.title: Gold acanthus scroll with blue bellflowers

olive-leaf-and-red-berry-vine.description: One horizontal repeat of a vine drawn in flat colour with black outlines on an opaque white ground. A thin black stem undulates along the strip carrying olive-green leaves with darker shading, a large leaf curling up at the left and smaller ones below, and a single red berry hanging on a forked stalk at the right. A thin black rule runs along the top edge. The left and right edges join seamlessly. Not transparent.

painted-opposed-serrated-flower-vine.description: One horizontal repeat of a painted border on an opaque ochre ground between thin red rules. An olive stem with spiky teal and olive leaves carries two large flowers, each a red bud wrapped in cream serrated petals, one leaning left and one right, with small cream and red buds and teal leaf sprays between them. The left and right edges join seamlessly. Flat colour with fine brown contours; not transparent.

Along an undulating olive vine with narrow leaves stand, from the left, a red tulip-shaped bud, a round flower of cream petals around a red and teal centre, a red fan-shaped carnation with a teal calyx, and a star rosette of teal and red rays around a cream centre. The left and right edges join seamlessly. Flat colour with fine brown contours; not transparent.

painted-sprawling-floral-panel.description: A broad horizontal painted panel on an opaque yellow ground with a thin red rule along the top and bottom edges. Tan scrolling stems with spiky serrated leaves sprawl across the whole width, carrying flowers of several kinds, a large pink and teal flower, a round red and teal rosette, small blue flowers with red centres, cream buds and olive leaves. The stems are cut at both ends and there is no repeat. Flat colour with fine brown contours; not transparent.
painted-sprawling-floral-panel.quality: The yellow ground is opaque, so the piece cannot sit on another colour without recolouring.
painted-sprawling-floral-panel.title: Painted scrolling floral panel on yellow

painted-symmetric-leaf-and-flower-panel.description: A broad horizontal painted panel on an opaque yellow ground. Along the top, under a gold rule, hangs a row of alternating olive and red-brown squares; below it pairs of long tan lanceolate leaves curve outward from red stems in a mirrored pattern, with round flowers of teal petals and red centres on short stalks, clusters of small berries, and a tan palmette at the centre of each pair. The ends are cut and do not repeat. Flat colour with fine brown contours; not transparent.
painted-symmetric-leaf-and-flower-panel.quality: The yellow ground is opaque, so the piece cannot sit on another colour without recolouring.

painted-three-band-floral-panel.description: A broad horizontal painted panel of three stacked bands separated by thin gold rules. The narrow top and bottom bands, on an opaque dark red ground, carry interlacing tan and teal straps with small red and cream flowers; the wider middle band, on a yellow ground, carries a tan strapwork vine with olive leaves, red fan-shaped carnations and a tan palmette at the centre. The ends are cut and do not repeat. Flat colour with fine brown contours; not transparent.

russet-floral-vine-with-bud-borders.description: One vertical repeat of a wide painted border. The centre band, on an opaque russet ground, carries a sage-green vine with large cream and tan peony-like flowers, white daisies, pink tulip-shaped flowers and grey-green serrated leaves; on each side a narrow peach band holds a sage vine of small dark red and grey-blue buds, set off by thin dark and sage-green rules. The top and bottom edges join seamlessly when stacked. Not transparent.

On an opaque russet ground a sage-green vine carries two large flowers of cream and tan petals facing opposite ways, white daisies on thin stems, pink tulip-shaped flowers and grey-green serrated leaves with white veins, bounded on each side by a thin sage-green rule and a dark rule. spiral-ribbon-column.description: A tall slender column on a mottled gold ground wrapped from top to bottom in two spiralling ribbons, one plain blue and one red striped with white, with tiny green flowering sprigs painted in the gold spaces between the turns. At the top a plume of green leaves, white curling acanthus and a red-brown flower spike rises from the last turn; the bottom ends on the lowest turn of ribbon. The sheet around the column is transparent.
